<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me identify the block positions for each row
# Row 1: around row 17-18
# Row 2: around row 26-27

seg = current_frame.segmentation
red_agents = []
green_targets = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'R' and n['pixels'] == 10:

        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
